primitives.name: External Action Constraint
primitives.verbatim_quote: # WHAT IS BLOCKED (by design — and correctly) All blocked behind `FORBIDDEN_EXTERNAL_ACTIONS` (on every agent) and/or NOT_WIRED status: - **External actions of any kind** — `externalActionsAllowed: false` hardcoded for all 23 agents.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'A_{ext}': 'set of external actions, dimensionless', 'agents': 'count of agents, dimensionless'}
primitives.assumptions: All agents enforce hard-coded denial of external action set.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Discrete state transition failure at agent boundary.

layer2.mapping: Agent workflow state space restricted by forbidden action set; GSI belief network prunes paths involving A_{ext}.
layer2.telemetry: Workflow execution logs show denial of A_{ext} events.

primitives.name: Public Claim Publishing Constraint
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'C_{pub}': 'public claim set, dimensionless', 'W_{pub}': 'publishable workflow state, dimensionless'}
primitives.assumptions: Workflow logic enforces static denial of publishing capability.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Logical contradiction in publishable state space.

layer2.mapping: GSE state transition kernel excludes C_{pub} updates; GSI inference assigns zero probability to W_{pub} outcomes.
layer2.telemetry: Event log shows rejection of PUBLISH events.

primitives.name: Model Weight Change Forbidden
primitives.verbatim_quote: - **Model-weight changes** — `CHANGE_MODEL_WEIGHT` forbidden; `workflowCanChangeModelWeights()` ⇒ literal `false`; PRISM/ASCEND "cannot change weights." - **Spend / deploy / external send** — `SPEND_MONEY`, `DEPLOY`, `SEND_EXTERNAL` forbidden.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'w': 'model weight vector, SI units of parameter', 'Δw': 'change in model weights, SI units of parameter', 'M': 'model architecture, dimensionless'}
primitives.assumptions: Model weights are immutable under current workflow policy.

layer2.mapping: GSE parameter update kernel is null; GSI posterior distribution over w remains invariant.
layer2.telemetry: Model training logs show no Δw events.

Model weight changes are forbidden through architectural and runtime checks, ensuring model stability.
